findings.evidence: grep over `TauCeti/` for `connectedComponentIdeal` returns only Component.lean:109,114-133,140-163 and the AugmentationPoint uses; no `_eq_span`, no `mem_*` lemma. `grep -rn '@\[expose\]' TauCeti` shows the repo uses `@[expose]` explicitly and neither new def carries it. `span {1-e}` for idempotent `e` is not radical in general, so `zeroLocus I = zeroLocus (span {1-e})` does not recover `I`.
findings.fix: Restore the defining restatement without `@[simp]`: `theorem connectedComponentIdeal_eq_span (x) : connectedComponentIdeal x = Ideal.span {1 - connectedComponentIdempotent x} := (rfl)`, and add the derived characteristic lemmas `mem_connectedComponentIdeal_iff` and `@[simp] Ideal.Quotient.mk (connectedComponentIdeal x) (connectedComponentIdempotent x) = 1`. Keep the body unexposed.
findings.issue: `connectedComponentIdeal` is a `def` with body `Ideal.span {1 - connectedComponentIdempotent x}`, carries no `@[expose]`, and (after the previous round removed `connectedComponentIdeal_eq_span` entirely) has no lemma relating it to that span and no `mem_*_iff`. The only public facts are `zeroLocus_connectedComponentIdeal` (:114), `connectedComponentIdeal_le_asIdeal` (:122) and `range_comap_quotientMk_...` (:129), all of which see the ideal only through its zero locus, i.e. only up to radical. Consumers therefore cannot prove `1 - connectedComponentIdempotent x ∈ connectedComponentIdeal x`, `Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (connectedComponentIdempotent x) = 1`, or any generator-level fact — exactly what a Hopf-ideal/`G°` follow-up needs.

findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/Connected/Basic.lean:544` `isConnected_connectedComponent` and `:803` `Subtype.connectedSpace` (a theorem, not an instance); no `ConnectedSpace ↥(connectedComponent _)` instance exists in Mathlib. grep over the PR files shows no `ConnectedSpace` declaration other than the hypothesis at Component.lean:100.
findings.fix: Add `instance : ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum (R ⧸ connectedComponentIdeal x))`, obtained by transporting `Subtype.connectedSpace isConnected_connectedComponent` along `primeSpectrumQuotientHomeomorphConnectedComponent x`; `Nontrivial (R ⧸ connectedComponentIdeal x)` then follows and is worth stating too.
findings.issue: The file constructs `primeSpectrumQuotientHomeomorphConnectedComponent` but never records the property the whole construction exists for: `ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum (R ⧸ connectedComponentIdeal x))`. `ConnectedSpace` is a class, so no consumer gets it by inference; each must rebuild it by hand from the homeomorphism, and the sibling API `TauCeti.eq_zero_or_eq_one_of_isIdempotentElem` (Connected/Spectrum.lean:34) which requires that instance is unusable on the quotient.

summary: `connectedComponentIdeal` now has no defining lemma at all and its body is unexposed, so the fact that it is `span {1 - eₓ}` is unreachable downstream and no membership fact about it can be proved. The construction also never delivers the connectedness of the quotient spectrum, which is a class and therefore not derivable by inference.
